verification.archive_verification_scope: Recorded from the successful read-only hash, ZIP integrity and all54 extracted-file byte-content checks earlier in this same analysis. The source ZIP subsequently became absent; the extracted files remain. No archive was deleted or moved by these analysis scripts.
verification.checkpoint_scope: Downloaded projection metadata reports frozen weight identities; original weight files are not in this package and have not been rehashed locally

protocol.comparison: Same case/stage is paired; train vs validation are different patients, same disease quotas, not severity-matched
protocol.full: Physical depth arithmetic mean, prepared center cube, saved XY maps
protocol.gt_span: Diagnostic only, not paper foreground or volume score
protocol.texture: highpass=image-Gaussian(sigma1); lowpass=Gaussian(sigma3); Pearson correlation, not vessel accuracy
protocol.limits: Only 10 training patients sampled; validation cases already used for checkpoint selection; no independent test or full3D re-audit
